description: The camera-lidar overlay that `calibrex check --html` wrote for FAST-LIVO hku2, copied unchanged from the check's evidence directory. It is the check's own drawing (src/calibrex/visualization/camera_lidar_check_overlay.py): one Livox Avia scan plus its registered neighbours, projected through the candidate calibration onto the left JPEG camera image and coloured by depth (red near, blue far).

bag.source: Hugging Face dataset DapengFeng/MCAP, FAST-LIVO/hku2 (ROS 2 MCAP conversion of the FAST-LIVO hku2 sequence)
bag.check_input_digest_scope: metadata.yaml in full; each storage file by name, size and first 64 MiB

fastlivo_camchain.yaml.built_from: FAST-LIVO config/avia.yaml (Rcl, Pcl) and config/camera_pinhole.yaml, intrinsics doubled for the 1280 x 1024 images; see docs/tutorials/calibrex_check.md, FAST-LIVO hku1 and hku2

fastlivo_frames.yaml.built_from: FAST-LIVO config/avia.yaml extrinsic_T (the LiDAR in the IMU frame, R = I)

check_result.overlay_note: overlay: the scan at 1577837173.15 s with 2 neighbouring scan(s) registered to it (51378 points) drawn on its image under the candidate and the estimate

reproduced: The same bytes were written by an earlier development run of the same command (before the v0.6.0 release) and by the v0.6.0 wheel.
data_status: FAST-LIVO hku1 and hku2 are spent development data for the tool, not evidence for a claim.
dataset_license: FAST-LIVO via DapengFeng/MCAP on Hugging Face, CC BY-NC 4.0: non-commercial use only, with attribution; the image contains a FAST-LIVO camera image and must stay non-commercial
